CRPF personnel injured in Kulgam terror attack

Three Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel were injured in a terror attack in Kulgam, Jammu and Kashmir. The incident occurred when motorcycle-borne terrorists opened fire on a CRPF team during a patrol or at a checkpoint. Two of the injured personnel sustained injuries to the leg and spine. A cordon and search operation has been launched to track down the attackers. Political leaders from the PDP and BJP condemned the attack.
